name: nav-item
description: Level 1 of the main navigation. Either a direct link (no children) or a flyout trigger whose flyout holds overview links plus level-2 links/groups.

link.description: Used only when the item has no children (direct link, e.g. Karriere / Shop).

overview_links.description: Shown at the top of the flyout (e.g. 'Übersicht', 'Innovationen', 'Unser Produktsortiment').

view.name: NavItem
view.notes: Flyout layout is derived from content: children with thumbnails -> thumbnail grid (fischer Produkte: 20 categories; fischertechnik Produkte: 5 tiles in 3 cols); nav-group children -> labelled columns (Service); plain nav-links -> simple list. Flyout: full-width, fixed under the 80px bar, bg #fff, shadow 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.06), close control 'Schließen' (code constant, translated via dictionary), opened on click. Active/hover marker: 3px var(--color-primary) underline.
